category: premium link generator / multi-host (global, PT-BR and ES storefronts)

free_tier.stated: No free allowance is published. The plan page contrasts a 'plano gratuito' (waiting and a quota) with Premium: 'Velocidade maxima Gere e baixe sem espera do plano gratuito' and 'Uso pessoal ilimitado Sem cota inicial quando o Premium esta ativo'.
free_tier.notes: The free plan is named but never quantified on the page.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: files stay on the third-party host, whose own per-file cap applies. No per-file cap is published.

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage. Link history is kept in the member panel; how long a generated link stays valid is not stated.

egress.terms: 'Uso pessoal ilimitado - Sem cota inicial quando o Premium esta ativo' (unlimited personal use, no initial quota once Premium is active). No per-GB price appears anywhere on the plan page.

interface_detail: The plan page lists 'Acesso a API - Use o MultiDebrid nos seus proprios apps e ferramentas' as a Premium feature. The endpoint is not published on the page; a member must obtain it.
tooling: The vendor's own API, plus the web panel and link history. Output is an HTTP direct link.
chaining: 52-host coverage behind one API key is the shape a batch archiver needs: a script posts a list of host URLs and gets direct links back, instead of the client holding logins at each host.

limits.value: 'Uso pessoal ilimitado' with no published byte cap, fair-use threshold or concurrent-link count
free tier has waiting and a 'starter quota'; numbers unpublished

limits_note: The only quantitative promise is the word 'ilimitado'. The site runs a 50%-discount banner, a voucher system and five resellers, which is a business that needs volume; nothing on the page says what volume it will serve.
binding_note: Nothing in the vocabulary is documented as failing at 1 TiB/month. The plausible failure is an unpublished fair-use ceiling, which would make it volume-quota; that is a guess with no page behind it, so the record stays at none.

identity_cost.detail: Account creation with email, confirmed in the payment flow ('You must confirm your account by email before subscribing' is AllDebrid's wording, not MultiDebrid's; MultiDebrid's page only offers 'criar uma conta' and a voucher field). The exact fields were not read because the plan grid never rendered.

reliability_note: Prices are rendered client-side and no read returned them, so the service is recorded but not priced. A reseller-voucher model means the buyer's recourse on a bad voucher is the reseller, not MultiDebrid.
confidence_note: Host count, API access, reseller list and the unlimited claim were read from the vendor's own plan page in Portuguese and English today. The price is unverified: the plan grid is JavaScript-rendered and returned no numbers. Opening the checkout would move the price to documented.

evidence.proved: Premium features as listed: 'Velocidade maxima', 'Uso pessoal ilimitado', 'Acesso a API', 'Historico de links', plus a voucher field

the five authorized resellers and their payment methods: filesharingkey, Plusinstant, Premiumkeystore.com, Takenkey, UTop.us; none is Brazilian or Spanish-language except UTop.us, which lists 'Ingles, Alemao, Espanhol'
the host count in the vendor's own title, 'Gerador de Links Premium para 52 Hosts Compativeis', and the host list beginning Rapidgator, Nitroflare, Turbobit, DDownload
a Spanish storefront exists with the same '52 filehosts' claim, so this is a global service localized into both Iberian languages, not a Latin American operator
'Supported hosts 52', 'Configured hosts 52', 'Premium plans 6', 'API access Available', 'Checks (24h) 65', 'Successful checks 80%', 'Last successful check 2026-10-23 01:38 UTC'
'Generate and download without free-tier waiting', 'No starter quota once Premium is active', 'API access', and the table of five authorised resellers

notes: MultiDebrid is the clearest case of a global service wearing LatAm clothes: /pt-br/ and /es/ storefronts, Portuguese and Spanish blog posts, and a reseller list that is entirely English-language. A Brazilian or Argentine buyer pays in EUR or USD through a foreign processor; the localization is marketing, not a local payment rail. A 2026-era entrant with a Turkish-first interface (the /tr pages render plan names and reseller copy) and an affiliate-style reseller network shared with other small providers. Recorded as a name to re-check with a logged-in session rather than as a priced option. Its 52-host count matches BestDebrid's exactly, which may mean a common supplier; that is unverified.

extras.price_status: unverified: plan grid client-rendered, no number returned by three reads
